headline: 154 active wildfires are burning uncontained in the US today. The most serious is the Old Trails Fire in WA, threatening 23,677 structures.

active_threats.name: Old Trails
active_threats.narrative: The Old Trails Fire in Spokane County, WA has burned 3,621 acres and is 0% contained. NIFC's incident team reports **23,677 structures threatened**. 381 personnel are assigned. Winds are expected to stay comparatively light over the next 24 hours (gusts near 8 mph), which should limit further wind-driven spread for now. This is a sustained, terrain-channeled wind regime — the setup our WindNinja terrain downscaling is built to resolve. Forecast wind (SW) is not currently aligned toward Airway Heights city, the nearest community of size, 3 miles away.
